red__prepmomfbd_fitsheaders.pro

includes main-level program

Routines

top source red::prepmomfbd_fitsheaders

SST pipeline

red::prepmomfbd_fitsheaders [, dirs=strarr] [, cfg_tag=string] [, momfbddir=string], mosaic=mosaic, no_narrowband=no_narrowband [, pref=string], scanno=scanno [, /no_pd]

Write FITS header files for expected MOMFBD output.

Keywords

dirs in optional type=strarr

The data "timestamp" directories to process.

cfg_tag in optional type=string

A short string to be added to the "cfg" part of the path.

momfbddir in optional type=string default=momfbd

Top directory of output tree.

mosaic
no_narrowband
pref in optional type=string

Prefilter.

scanno
no_pd in optional type=boolean

Set this to exclude phase diversity data and processing.
